question: What state of the great-souled one should the devotee be united with?
premises: A state called wine-bliss-consciousness is named.
This consciousness belongs to a great-souled one.
The practitioner is endowed with devotion.
inference: Therefore the devotee should be united with the wine-bliss-consciousness of the great-souled one.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of the compound as object of an implied action is inferred.
plain_english: Endowed with devotion, one should be united with the wine-bliss-consciousness of the great-souled one.
